purpose: Check a small set of inventory phrases in one mixed vector/image page of an official Shopee Uni guide using the production document processor.
reference_method: Selected Vietnamese phrases were manually checked against the rendered source page; this is not a full-page transcription.
limitations: This is one mixed vector-text and embedded-screenshot page from a historical 2019 Shopee Vietnam seller guide, not a physical scan and not a representative OCR benchmark.
Anchor recall measures only the selected phrases; CER and WER are intentionally not scored from a partial transcription.
The guide applies to Shopee sellers only and is not current policy for the synthetic Commerce dataset.

text_anchors: Mức độ cần bổ sung hàng
